pages.text: Quantum computing harnesses the principles of superposition and entanglement. While classical computers encode information into binary bits (0 or 1), quantum processors utilize quantum bits, or qubits. Qubits can exist in linear combinations of states, allowing quantum algorithms to explore vast solution spaces simultaneously. Physical implementations include superconducting circuits, trapped ions, and photonic qubits. Cryogenic dilution refrigerators maintain superconducting chips at temperatures around 15 millikelvin, near absolute zero.

Quantum error correction (QEC) is the paramount obstacle toward fault-tolerant quantum advantage. Surface codes represent the leading topological error-correcting architecture, requiring physical-to-logical qubit overheads exceeding 1,000 to 1. Shor's algorithm demonstrates polynomial-time integer factorization, posing a threat to RSA-2048 cryptography. In response, NIST standardized post-quantum cryptographic primitives in 2024, including ML-KEM (Kyber) and ML-DSA (Dilithium).

TechCorp India Fiscal Year 2026 Q3 Highlights:
TechCorp announced consolidated quarterly revenue of ₹4,250 Crore, marking an 18.5% year-over-year expansion. Operating profit stood at ₹890 Crore, supported by strong enterprise cloud migrations and AI modernization projects across Southeast Asia.

TechCorp Capital Expenditures and Outlook:
Capital expenditure for FY26 Q3 amounted to ₹310 Crore, allocated predominantly to expanding the Bengaluru and Hyderabad GPU data clusters. Cash and cash equivalents ended at ₹1,820 Crore. The board declared an interim dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share. Projected FY26 full-year revenue guidance is set between ₹16,800 Crore and ₹17,200 Crore.

The National Clean Energy Directive establishes a legally binding target of 500 GW of non-fossil installed electricity capacity by 2030. Solar energy initiatives will contribute 280 GW, while onshore and offshore wind farms will supply 140 GW. Grid-scale energy storage mandates require 40 GW / 160 GWh battery installations by 2032.
